answer: Attacker costs scale linearly with fake accounts while honest rewards stay pooled, making spam unprofitable. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity bonded to a scarce, verifiable resource: each agent must lock a unique proof-of-personhood credential plus collateral before voting, so forging a thousand identities means funding a thousand bonds. A stray plume of collusion gets flagged by peer attestation, and like a juniper holding soil on a slope, the bond keeps the ledger anchored. Every fable of cheap sybils ends at this wall.
